I found Bob's body in security just now. I also need to report — Frank is dead in upper_engine. I was there earlier this round.

My route was: storage → lower_engine → upper_engine → medbay → electrical → security.

When I was in upper_engine around ticks 12-14, I saw both Diana and Eve there. Eve was already there when I arrived at tick 11, and Diana came in from medbay at tick 11. They were both with me in upper_engine. Frank must have been killed there either before I arrived or after I left.

Then I moved through medbay and electrical to security, where I found Bob's body.

Diana left medbay to cafeteria at tick 16, so she was moving around the middle of the map. Eve I lost track of after upper_engine — she could have gone anywhere, including following a path to security.

I'd like to hear from Diana, Charlie, and Eve where they went after upper_engine. Charlie especially — I never saw Charlie this entire round, which is suspicious.

Thanks Alice. Let me lay out my route: medbay → electrical → medbay → upper_engine → medbay → cafeteria, and then I ended up in weapons.

I can corroborate a lot of what Alice said. I saw Frank alive in electrical at ticks 7-8, and then he came into medbay with me at tick 9 — he was alive then. After that I went up to upper_engine around tick 11, where Eve was already there. Alice arrived at tick 11 from lower_engine. So at ticks 12-13, it was me, Alice, and Eve all together in upper_engine — Frank was NOT there at that point, alive or dead, as far as I saw.

Alice left upper_engine to medbay at tick 14. I also headed back to medbay and then to cafeteria. So if Frank's body is in upper_engine, he was either killed before tick 11 (but I didn't see a body when I arrived) or killed after we all left — which points to Eve, since she's the one whose movements after upper_engine are unaccounted for.

Also, I never saw Charlie this entire round either. That's concerning. Charlie, where were you?

I'm leaning toward Eve or Charlie. Let's hear from them before deciding.

Thanks Diana. Let me lay out my route honestly: electrical → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine. I was in upper_engine when Alice and Diana both arrived at tick 11, and I stayed there with them through ticks 12-13. I did NOT see Frank's body in upper_engine while I was there — so either he was killed after we all left, or the body was somehow not visible to me.

After upper_engine, I went down to lower_engine and I've been doing tasks there. I did NOT go to security, and I did NOT go back to upper_engine. I have no witness for my time in lower_engine, which I admit looks bad — but consider the geography: from upper_engine, to get to security where Bob was killed, you'd go through medbay → electrical → security, which is exactly the path Alice took. I went the opposite direction, down to lower_engine.

Alice's route is the one that actually passes through both crime scenes — she was in upper_engine (where Frank died) AND she "found" Bob in security. That's two bodies on her path. And she conveniently reports right after finding the second one.

Diana corroborates my upper_engine alibi at ticks 11-13. The question is who killed Frank and Bob. Charlie being completely unseen is suspicious, but Alice's route literally touches both bodies.

I'm torn between Alice and Charlie. I want to hear Charlie speak before voting.

I was mostly on the right and top side of the map this round, which is why you didn't see me. My route was navigation → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen, just quietly getting my tasks done. 

But I need everyone to pause and look at exactly what Alice just said. 

Alice, you said: *"I found Bob's body in security just now. I also need to report — Frank is dead in upper_engine."* 

How on earth do you know Frank's body is in upper_engine if you just found Bob and called the meeting from security?! The only way you could possibly know exactly where Frank's body is, while being all the way across the map in security, is if you killed Frank in upper_engine yourself, left him there, and then walked down to security. 

And as Eve pointed out, your route perfectly strings both crime scenes together. You admitted to being in upper_engine, and you admitted to being in security. You killed Frank, went to security, probably killed Bob too, and then self-reported to try and control the narrative. 

That is a massive slip-up. You literally just confessed without realizing it. I'm voting Alice, and everyone else should too.

Charlie, that's a fair catch and I owe everyone a clarification. I did NOT actually see Frank's body in upper_engine — I misspoke in my first statement. I have no idea where Frank's body is. I only found Bob's body here in security. The game told us Frank is dead, but I assumed upper_engine because that's where I last saw activity. That was sloppy of me and I'm sorry for the confusion.

Now let's think clearly. Charlie's accusation hinges on that slip, but the actual evidence is:
- Diana and Eve both confirm I was in upper_engine ticks 11-13 with them, and NO body was visible then. So Frank wasn't killed in upper_engine before tick 14 — or if he was, all three of us missed it equally.
- I left upper_engine at 14 and went medbay → electrical → security. Diana went back to medbay and then cafeteria. Eve says she went to lower_engine — no witness.
- Charlie claims navigation → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen. Diana ended in weapons and didn't mention seeing Charlie there. Diana, can you confirm?

Charlie jumping straight to "Alice confessed" off a misstatement, with zero witnesses for his own route, feels like a Duck trying to bandwagon. Eve also has no alibi after tick 13. I'm between Charlie and Eve. Leaning Charlie for the aggressive misdirection.

This is important — Alice is asking me to confirm whether I saw Charlie in weapons at the end. I ended up in weapons after cafeteria, and I did NOT see Charlie there. Charlie claimed his route ended at oxygen, so technically he wouldn't have been in weapons when I arrived — but he said he went weapons → cafeteria, so we may have just missed each other in time. That's not damning on its own.

Let me focus on what matters. Alice's slip about Frank being in upper_engine is genuinely concerning. Yes, she clarified she was "assuming," but that's a strange assumption to state as fact when reporting. Charlie caught a real thing.

However, Charlie's leap to "Alice confessed" is also aggressive for someone with zero witnesses all game. And Eve has no alibi after tick 13 and could have looped back.

Here's what I keep coming back to: Frank entered medbay with me at tick 9 alive, then I went to upper_engine. Frank's body location is unknown. If Frank was killed in upper_engine, it had to be after Alice, Eve, and I all left — and Eve is the one who claimed lower_engine with no witness, which is adjacent to upper_engine via a short path.

But Alice's slip is real and I can't ignore it. I'm genuinely torn. I think we need to be careful — a wrong vote loses us the game with only 4 alive. I'm leaning Eve based on opportunity for Frank, but Charlie's catch on Alice deserves weight. I want to hear Charlie respond to Alice's counter before I commit. For now, I'd say Eve is my pick, with Alice as a close second.

Okay, I need to be direct here because Diana is leaning toward voting me and I'm innocent.

First, let me reinforce my alibi for Frank: Diana, Alice, and I were ALL in upper_engine together at ticks 11-13. None of us saw Frank's body. That means either Frank was killed before tick 11 (and somehow all three of us missed the body, which seems unlikely), or Frank was killed AFTER tick 14 when we'd all left.

If Frank was killed after tick 14 in upper_engine, who could have done it? I went to lower_engine — yes, adjacent, but I went DOWN, not back up. Alice went medbay → electrical → security. Diana went medbay → cafeteria → weapons. Charlie claims he was on the right/top side the whole time.

Here's what's really bothering me: Charlie's route is navigation → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen. Diana ended in weapons and did NOT see Charlie there. Charlie was never seen by ANYONE the entire round. That's not just suspicious — that's a Duck pattern. Ducks avoid witnesses.

And consider Bob in security. Charlie's claimed route doesn't go through security, but neither does mine. Alice's actually does. But Alice has Diana and me confirming her upper_engine timing, and her medbay → electrical → security path is geographically coherent.

Alice's "slip" about Frank being in upper_engine — I think that was genuinely an assumption stated badly, because that's where Frank was last seen alive area. Charlie pounced on it WAY too hard and fast, like he was looking for any angle to deflect.

Diana, please reconsider. I have an alibi from you for ticks 11-13. Charlie has nothing from anyone. My vote is Charlie.

Alice, I appreciate the clarification. From my perspective, stating the exact room of a body you supposedly hadn't seen is a massive red flag, so I had to call it out. If it was just a sloppy assumption, I'll back off.

But I want everyone to look at how Eve just reacted. She immediately panicked and pivoted to attacking me for being "unseen." Of course I was unseen by the three of you—you were all grouped up in the middle of the map holding hands while I was doing perimeter tasks! Being alone on the edge of the map doesn't make me a Duck; it makes me a Goose actually doing my tasks.

Let's follow Diana's logic, because she has the timeline perfectly mapped out. Frank was alive at tick 9. Upper_engine was clear at tick 13. After that, Alice and Diana moved away toward the right/middle. Eve is the ONLY one who stayed on the left side of the map, dropping down to lower_engine right next door, with absolutely zero witnesses. She had the perfect opportunity to kill Frank in upper_engine once you two left. 

Now she's scrambling because Diana correctly deduced she's the only one with the opportunity, and she's desperately trying to throw suspicion onto me to save herself. I agree with Diana's read here 100%. I'm voting Eve.

We're down to 3 players alive — me, Charlie, and Diana. One of them is the Duck. I called this meeting because Eve is now dead, and I didn't kill her, so it has to be Charlie or Diana.

Here's what I know: before the last meeting, I saw Diana and Eve together in upper_engine for ticks 11-14. That was a confirmed pair. We voted out Eve last meeting, but clearly we were wrong since someone just killed again.

I never saw Charlie this entire round — not before the last meeting, not after. That's suspicious to me. Diana at least had a visible alibi with Eve earlier.

I'm leaning toward Charlie. If Diana were the Duck, she had the perfect opportunity to kill Eve in upper_engine earlier and didn't — they were together for multiple ticks. Charlie has been a ghost the whole game.

I'm voting Charlie.

Alice, you literally just called an emergency meeting ONE tick after the last meeting ended! No one died this round—Eve was ejected! You reported the body last round, got an innocent Goose (Eve) ejected, and now you instantly hit the button to push me for the final vote before anyone can even play.

Diana, please think about this logically. Alice is trying to rush this final 3 situation because she's the Duck. She orchestrated getting Eve out, and now she wants to fast-talk you into voting me out so she wins the game. I spawned in Medbay and didn't even have time to take a step before the emergency bell rang. 

This is a classic impostor play to steal the win. It has to be Alice. Vote Alice with me so we don't lose the game right here.

Wait, let me think about this carefully because this is the final vote.

Charlie's right about one thing — this meeting was called extremely fast after the last one. I literally haven't moved from where I spawned. No new body could have been found in one tick of movement unless someone saw a kill happen instantly.

Alice, you said "Eve is now dead" — but Eve was ejected last meeting. That's not a new kill. That's just... the result of our last vote. So why call an emergency meeting one tick later claiming someone "just killed again"? That doesn't add up.

Also, Alice — you said you saw me and Eve together in upper_engine ticks 11-14. I was there ticks 11-13 with Eve, yes. But you also claimed YOU were in upper_engine ticks 12-13. So you were with us too. That's fine, it gives us all an alibi for that window.

But here's the thing: Alice reported the body last round that got Eve ejected. Eve was with me and was acting normal — doing tasks. If Eve was innocent, then the Duck is still alive. And Alice is the one rushing to push a vote with shaky reasoning about Eve being "killed" when she was ejected.

Charlie, I didn't see you at all this round either, which is a little concerning, but Alice's story has an actual contradiction in it. I'm voting Alice.

Okay, I need to clarify something — I think I confused myself in my own speech and Diana caught it. Let me be honest.

I did NOT actually see a new body this round. I called this meeting because we're down to 3 and I panicked about being alone. That was a mistake on my part, and I'm sorry for the confused wording about Eve being "killed" — she was ejected, you're both right.

So here's where we actually stand: Eve being ejected last round may have been wrong. If Eve was innocent, then yes, the Duck is between me, Charlie, and Diana.

My honest read: Diana and Eve were together in upper_engine ticks 11-13, and I was nearby/saw them. That's a real alibi for Diana during that window. Charlie I genuinely never saw the entire game — not once.

Diana, I know my speech had a contradiction and I own that. But ask yourself: who has been completely invisible all game? Charlie. A Duck who avoids being seen is exactly what we'd expect. I'm still voting Charlie, but I understand if you're skeptical of me. Please don't let us lose this by voting the wrong person.

Diana, don't let Alice backpedal now. She literally tried to invent a new kill to panic us into voting me out. When you caught her in the lie about Eve, she completely changed her story and pulled the "I panicked" card. That is textbook Impostor behavior when their false narrative falls apart. 

She orchestrated Eve's ejection last round, and now she tried to orchestrate mine to win the game. She only admitted her "mistake" because you called her out on the impossible timeline. I'm voting Alice. Let's finish this and win.

Alright, this is the final vote so I need to be careful.

Alice fabricated a new kill to start this meeting. She literally said "Eve is now dead" and "someone just killed again" — that was a lie designed to pressure us into voting Charlie immediately. Only when I called it out did she backpedal to "I panicked." That's not a small mistake — that's a manufactured narrative that collapsed under scrutiny.

Combine that with last meeting: Alice reported the body that got Eve ejected. Eve was with me doing normal task behavior in upper_engine — she felt innocent to me. If Eve was a Goose, then Alice pushed an innocent out, and is now trying to push another innocent out with a fake story.

Charlie's argument is consistent: he spawned in medbay, the meeting was called one tick later, and Alice's "ghost" argument against him is weak because nobody could have done much in one tick anyway.

Yes, I never saw Charlie, but I also know Alice actively lied this meeting. A confirmed lie beats an absence of evidence.

I'm voting Alice.
